Use this tool when you need to manually start a new run of a DAG.

run. You can use the `get_dag_run` tool to poll for state changes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_environment · Private data: create_environment, get_dag, list_import_errors · Public sink: list_import_errors · Destructive: delete_environment, manage_pypi_packages, get_dag_source_code, get_dag_run, find_last_failed_dag_runs, list_failed_task_instances, trigger_dag.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_environment · Private data: create_environment, get_dag, list_import_errors · Public sink: list_import_errors · Destructive: delete_environment, manage_pypi_packages, get_dag_source_code, get_dag_run, find_last_failed_dag_runs, list_failed_task_instances, trigger_dag

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
